name: Mid macro-regime (between) + calm VIX arms double-confirmed oversold (bb_z AND RSI)
rationale: THESIS: require BOTH oversold definitions to agree (bb_z band-relative AND rsi momentum-relative) to cut false washouts, armed only in a MIDDLE macro_regime band (between) — the idea is that extreme-high regime readings are late-cycle euphoria where reversion fails on the upside and extreme-low are breakdowns; the durable reversion lives in the middle, with calm vix. Double-confirmation lowers turnover further (rare co-occurrence), so 10bps barely bites. DISCONFIRMER 1 (is the band a disguised one-sided gate?): a macro gt-only sibling tests whether the lower edge of the band matters. DISCONFIRMER 2 (does double-confirmation beat single?): spec-1 (bb_z-only) and spec-2 (rsi-only) under their gates are the single-trigger baselines; if double is not better risk-adjusted it only cost trades. DISCONFIRMER 3 (just reversion?): ungated double-oversold control. DISCONFIRMER 4 (holdout).
catalyst: macro_regime in a fitted mid band AND vix calm AND both bb_z and rsi oversold
